maya (sec): Heads-up — we need to finalize the plan for Audit Events v3 before next week's customer preview. Main concerns: which fields are removed, schema versioning header, dual-write rollout, and KMS implications for event payloads.

jordan (infra): Can you list the exact fields slated for removal? we should check downstream consumers first.

maya (sec): Short list: `user_email` (PII moved to separate identity service), `raw_request_body` (too big / PII), and `legacy_role` (replaced by `roles` array). We'll add `event_version` top-level.

samir (eng-platform): For compatibility, we can add `event_version` and keep v2 write for 90 days. Are we doing dual writes (v2+v3) or transform-on-read?

elaine (compliance): Dual writes preferred for audit trail integrity. Transform-on-read can hide original evidence. Customers will want verifiable history.

diego (sre): KMS note: if `user_email` is removed, we must ensure anything we redact was previously encrypted or archived per retention. Also audit log storage encryption must remain compatible with KMS key rotation.

maya (sec): Agreed on dual-write for the window. Plan proposal: 1) Add `event_version` and `schema_version` fields. 2) Dual-write v2+v3 for 8 weeks. 3) Run customer validation tests during weeks 3-6. 4) After 8 weeks, stop v2 write and keep a read-only v2 archive for 12 months.

jordan (infra): Implementation notes: will need a feature flag to enable v3 writes per service. We'll route by service flag then fallback to v2 if flag off. Also need a migration toggle to copy historical events to v3-only archive for queries.

samir (eng-platform): Example of proposed v3 header and payload snippet: ```json
{
  "event_version": "3",
  "schema_version": "2026-03-20",
  "event_type": "model.infer.call",
  "actor": { "id": "usr_123", "roles": ["developer"] },
  "resource": { "id": "mdl_abc", "type": "model" },
  "meta": { "request_id": "rid_789" },
  "payload": { "input_summary": "...", "output_summary": "..." }
}
```

maya (sec): Note: `input_summary` must not contain raw prompt text unless customers opt in. We need an opt-in mechanism and KMS encryption for opt-in fields.

elaine (compliance): For customer-facing audit validation, we'll provide a signed schema contract + sample events and a test harness. Customers can run their validators against a _preview_ dataset. Also need to update SOC2 evidence for audit retention changes.

diego (sre): KMS impact specifics: opt-in fields should be encrypted using customer-managed keys (CMKs) when available. We must add key_id to event metadata: `encryption: { "key_type":"cmk|platform", "key_id":"..." }`. Also document behavior during key rotation and revocation.

jordan (infra): For RBAC: removing `legacy_role` means policy evaluation needs to reference `roles` array. We'll coordinate with IAM to publish mapping & migration guidance. Breaking change for internal tools that still expect `legacy_role`. Need a deprecation warning emitted to logs for 30 days before v3-only.

samir (eng-platform): Rollout steps (draft): \n- Week 0: Launch feature flags + v3 schema + docs.
- Week 1-2: Opt-in previews for internal teams + export preview dataset.
- Week 3-6: Customer validation window (invite list).
- Week 7: Deprecation announcements + final compatibility checks.
- Week 8: Stop v2 writes, keep read-only v2 archive.

maya (sec): Action items: \n- @samir: implement v3 header + dual-write flag (owner)\n- @jordan: infra rollout plan + migration toggle for archives (owner)\n- @elaine: customer validation harness + compliance impact doc (owner)\n- @diego: KMS key handling doc + rotation playbook (owner)\n- @maya: draft customer-facing deprecation email and FAQ (owner)

samir (eng-platform): I'll start a PR with the schema and feature-flag hooks today, link once ready.

jordan (infra): I'll schedule a staging deploy with dual-write turned on for internal test namespace.

auditsvc-bot: Deployment started: auditsvc v2->v3 dual-write feature to staging (build 2026.45).

maya (sec): Great — please ping when staging has sample events. We should run the validation harness against them.

elaine (compliance): Also: customers in regulated industries may require longer v2 archive retention. I'll surface a contractual change in the FAQ.

diego (sre): One more: incident response — if v3 causes malformed events, have a rollback plan to stop v3 writes immediately. Add runbook step for toggling off and rerouting to v2 archive for forensic queries.

maya (sec): Yep — include runbook in the PR. If no objections, I'll consolidate this thread into the migration playbook doc and assign PR reviewers.

jordan (infra): No objections. thanks all.

maya (sec): Thanks — creating playbook now.
